about: The trainer AI knows Earth Eater swallows a Ground move (flag 0, trainer_ai_script.c 2975). Falkner's Hoothoot is taught Mud-Slap and Leer once the battle is up and faces an Orthworm, whose only ability is Earth Eater, that only Splashes: it Leers every turn. Before the fix Mud-Slap, twice effective on a Steel-type, was rated as a hit and used about every other turn, each one healing the Orthworm.
